text:
maria: Hey folks — seeing a persistent delta in session_duration_agg for EU starting ~2026-03-18. Dashboard shows ~9% underreported for the last 48h. Do we want a coordinated replay?

owen: Ack. Linked the agg dashboard: https://console.redwood/dashboards/agg/session_duration?region=eu :eyes: Do we know if this is late ingest vs a compute bug?

infra-bot: alert: EU-ingest-lag > 2h for topic telemetry-events (broker-eu-02). Occurrences: 14 in last 6h.

jia: I sampled raw events — lots of late-arrival events where ingestion_ts << arrival_ts. Looks like SQS redrive + a few producers re-sending. I can extract event_ids for dedupe check.

sam: Important customer-facing metric. Recompute will spike token/unit usage. Any rough estimate on processed_count?

ben: For throughput control, use replay-tool v2. Example command:
```
replay-tool replay --since 2026-03-18T00:00Z --until 2026-03-20T12:00Z --topic telemetry-events --shards 10 --idempotent --dedupe-key=event_id --throttle=800r/s
```
This stays under current quota if we cap to 800 r/s per region.

diana: We should canary first (10% weight) and track session_duration_mean and session_duration_count on a canary dashboard. Also temporarily route traffic priority so live requests don't degrade.

owen: Quota note: replay will hit dedicated pools if we don't tag requests. We should create a "backfill" quota bucket and enforce at the router (region policy). I can provision.

maria: Proposed plan: 1) Canary on shards 0-1 for 6h at 10% weight. 2) Validate canary metrics + error logs. 3) Ramp across shards with 30m holds. 4) Full run with quota cap. Owners: @owen infra, @jia dedupe, @ben replay ops, @diana rollout UX.

jia: Two flags we need: `--dedupe-window=7d` and `--skip-reinject-failed=true`. Also ensure idempotency table has indexes on (dedupe_key, partition) to avoid hot writes.

sam: Add a dashboard tile "backfill-progress" with processed_count, error_rate, and avg_latency. Alert if error_rate > 1% or processed_rate < expected for 20m.

ben: Small operational concern: replay-tool v2 has a kafka ack bug when --shards>10. Patch scheduled tomorrow. If we need >10 shards for speed, we'd have to temporarily disable acks (dup risk). Suggest keep <=10 shards and extend window.

diana: UX suggestion for the console: add a "Start backfill" modal to set canary %, throttle, quota label. Low-effort but prevents manual CLI mistakes. I'll file a short ticket.

maria: Risk register: duplicates, cost, potential SLO blips on aggregate dashboards. Mitigations: dedupe at consume, quota-limited runs, canary checks, and rollback plan (stop replay + mark problematic partitions). Any objections?

owen: No objections. I'll provision the quota bucket and add a router throttle policy for EU with label=backfill.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: replay-tool v2 patch candidate pushed to staging at 2039123460; CI status: green.

ben: I'll kick off the canary once deploy is verified and post logs to #eng-platform/backfill-logs. ETA: will start at ~2039123560.

jia: I'll run a small rehydrate locally (1000 events) to validate dedupe + idempotent upserts. Will report back in 30m.

sam: On-call for metrics during canary: sam.metrics. Will watch dashboards and call rollback if SLOs degrade.

maria: Thanks — creating a short runbook snippet in docs and will post the runbook link here once it's up. Next update in 2h or after canary starts.
